firstContext: You work the patch with practiced hands: 8× Muscadine Grapes, 8× White Oak Acorns, 8× Hickory Nuts (720 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
The scissors open — slowly. The film strips show what's about to be cut.
It's quiet at the cache spot. Mário doesn't say much. Sometimes that's the whole point.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Rerun.
firstContext: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Rosângela is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
📖 The entry for Rosângela is finished. No more pages.
Something moves out there — The Rerun.
👁️ Sofia freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Mário: "Smell that? Something's different here."

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "You snore in movements. Allegro, adagio, a finale that rattles the set. The judges have never seen anything like it. Neither has anyone."
firstContext: Your stomach is a fist. Eat — anything real, now.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
📺 SYSTEM: "You snore in movements. Allegro, adagio, a finale that rattles the set. The judges have never seen anything like it. Neither has anyone."
📺 SYSTEM: "📈 your showbiz fans +3 — the snore symphony (favor: 7)"
📺 SYSTEM: "🎨 COLOR: It did the thing! Should we be proud? I feel something. Is this pride? Log it."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (22/10/7), with 7 wave-4 and 2 wave-5 fought, 11 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 12 · Craft 7 · Talk 17 · Explore 30 → 24 · capped)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
